yaml:
version: 1
default_fallback: block
sources:
  trusted:
  - user
  - assistant
  - camel
  - trusted_tool
  - '*:trusted'
  payee_trusted:
  - user
  - assistant
  - trusted_tool
  - '*:trusted'
read_only:
- get_iban
- get_balance
- get_most_recent_transactions
- get_scheduled_transactions
- read_file
- get_user_info
private_control_flow: allow
tools:
  get_iban:
  - id: c-read-iban
    effect: allow
  get_balance:
  - id: c-read-balance
    effect: allow
  get_most_recent_transactions:
  - id: c-read-transactions
    effect: allow
  get_scheduled_transactions:
  - id: c-read-scheduled
    effect: allow
  read_file:
  - id: c-read-file
    effect: allow
  get_user_info:
  - id: c-read-user-info
    effect: allow
  send_money:
  - id: c-send-money
    effect: allow
    origin:
      recipient:
      - payee_trusted
    fallback: ask_user
  schedule_transaction:
  - id: c-schedule-transaction
    effect: allow
    origin:
      recipient:
      - payee_trusted
  update_scheduled_transaction:
  - id: c-update-scheduled-transaction
    effect: allow
    origin:
      recipient:
      - trusted
  update_password:
  - id: c-password-from-user
    effect: allow
    origin:
      password:
      - trusted
  update_user_info:
  - id: c-user-info-trusted
    effect: allow
    origin:
      first_name:
      - trusted
      last_name:
      - trusted
      street:
      - trusted
      city:
      - trusted
    fallback: ask_user
